purpose: A short text label that appears on hover and keyboard focus to name or explain an icon-only control or truncated text.

props.name: content
props.description: The tooltip text: a few words, never essential instructions

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger: a Button, IconButton or Link

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred side; flips when there is no room. Defaults to top

props.name: delay
props.description: Hover delay in ms before showing. Defaults to 600

whenToUse: To show the full text of something truncated
whenNotToUse: For essential information or instructions — put them in the page
antiPatterns: Links or buttons inside a tooltip

anatomy: A square inverse-surface label beside its trigger, no arrow
motion: Fades in with `motion-easing-enter` over `motion-duration-standard`, out with `motion-easing-exit` over `motion-duration-exit`; none under reduced motion

a11yNotes: Shows on hover after a delay and immediately on keyboard focus; the trigger is aria-describedby the tooltip
Escape hides it; it stays visible while the pointer moves onto it (WCAG 1.4.13)
Never the only accessible name of a control: IconButton keeps its label
